title: Past Simple: Was / Were
objectives: Geçmiş zamanda to be fiilini was / were ile kullanmak
Olumsuz (wasn't / weren't) ve soru biçimlerini kurmak
There was / there were ile geçmişteki varlığı anlatmak
Geçmiş zaman ifadelerini (yesterday, ago, in 2010) kullanmak

sections.title: To be fiilinin geçmişi
paragraphs: Geçmişte bir durumu, yeri ya da özelliği anlatmak için am / is / are yerine was ve were kullanılır: “Dün evdeydim”, “Çok mutluyduk”, “Hava soğuktu”.
Was ve were Past Simple’ın be fiilidir. Diğer fiillerden farklı olarak did yardımcı fiili gerektirmez; olumsuz ve soru biçimleri doğrudan be fiiliyle kurulur.

forms.label: I / he / she / it → was
forms.formula: I was,  he was,  she was,  it was

forms.label: you / we / they → were
forms.formula: you were,  we were,  they were
forms.note: Çoğul özneler ve you were alır.

sections.title: Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't
paragraphs: Olumsuz için was not (wasn’t) ve were not (weren’t) kullanılır. Do / did gerekmez.

sections.title: Soru ve kısa cevap
paragraphs: Soruda was / were özneden önce gelir. Kısa cevap Yes, … was / were. ya da No, … wasn’t / weren’t. biçimindedir.

formulas.label: Kısa cevap
formulas.pattern: Yes, I was.   No, she wasn’t.

sections.title: There was / There were
paragraphs: “Vardı” anlamı için there was (tekil ve sayılamayan) ve there were (çoğul) kullanılır. Kural there is / are ile aynıdır, yalnızca zaman geçmiştir.

sections.title: Geçmiş zaman ifadeleri
paragraphs: Past Simple ile bitmiş zamanı gösteren ifadeler kullanılır: yesterday, last night / week / year, in 2010, two days ago. “I was born” (doğdum) kalıbı da was ile kurulur.

formulas.label: İfadeler
formulas.pattern: yesterday,  last night,  in 2010,  two days ago,  this morning

formulas.label: Doğmak
formulas.pattern: I was born in + yıl / şehir

sections.title: Örnekler: soru, there was ve zaman

items.body: Am / is / are şimdiki zaman; was / were geçmiş zamandır.
Diğer fiiller did ile olumsuz ve soru kurar; be fiili kurmaz.

sections.title: Dikkat edilecekler
items: I / he / she / it → was; you / we / they → were.
Soruda was / were özneden önce gelir.
There was tekil, there were çoğul isimle kullanılır.
“Doğmak” was born ile söylenir: I was born in 1995.

examples.en: The children were in the garden.
There was a book on the table.
She was ill two days ago.
